text:
marta: Heads-up — noticed higher token latency in canary yesterday on the fused-paged Flash variant (fp8). Avg p95 went from 48ms -> 120ms on long-form prompts.
jon: ugh, any repro? sequence lengths, batch sizes?
marta: Repro script attached in thread: ran microbench with seq=1024, batch=2, kv_prefetch=on. Nsight trace shows repeated softmax re-evals and a lot of kernel fallthroughs.
samir: can you paste the perf counters?
marta: perf dump: 
```
KERNEL_CALLS: fused_paged_flashx: 430
KERNEL_CALLS: fallback_flash: 790
SOFTMAX_OVERFLOWS: 12
FP8_CLAMPS: 24
KV_HIT_RATE: 0.11
```

tina: SOFTMAX_OVERFLOWS set off alarms — looks numerical. Is the fp8 scaling different in this build?
marta: I bisected to commit 8f3a2b where we swapped softmax scaling factor from /sqrt(dk) to /sqrt(dk)*0.5 for stability experiments. Before that, no overflows.
jon: that scaling change would increase logits magnitude -> more fp8 saturations. Why did fused kernel apply a different guard than fallback?
samir: suspicious — kernel selector has a heuristic: if seq>512 and kv_prefetch enabled -> choose fused_paged_flashx. It assumes softmax_guard enabled, but guard flag was introduced in a later commit and not toggled in canary config. So fused got no extra clamping.
marta: repro patch: altered selector to require `softmax_safe=true` for fused. Rerun: SOFTMAX_OVERFLOWS=0, p95 back to 50ms.
tina: great catch. But need to ensure we don't lose throughput — adding unnecessary clamps can slow fused path. Can we add a lightweight numeric pre-check instead?
jon: propose: runtime micro-probe that samples max_qk per batch window (first 64 tokens) and if > threshold, enable softmax-clamp for that request only. Cheap and per-request.
marta: implemented quick probe: `max_qk = max(abs(Q @ K^T).max())` on first block; threshold=30 for fp8. Perf: additional 2ms overhead in 3% of requests, prevents overflow in 100% of repro runs.
samir: logger that emits `softmax_probe=1` for traces, add metric `probe_true_rate`.
perf-bot: deploy-green: canary rollout to 10% with probe enabled in fused_paged_flashx. CI perf regression check queued. :rocket:
marta: added unit test that simulates pathological token distributions (long repeats) and checks no fp8 clamping occurs unless probe trips.
tina: also add docs note in kernel-selector config for `softmax_safe` flag and default false for now.
jon: follow-up: run nvprof on a few failing samples to ensure no hidden memory reorder caused by prefetching KV interacts with probe.
marta: queued, will post traces. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
